title: autotune: default batching/caching + quant profiles + unit-econ tooling
author: Priya Menon
release_notes:
- Add Autotune controller for batching and KV-cache defaults
- Add curated quantization profile catalog and mapping rules
- Add unit-economics dashboard and CLI for cost simulation
body: Context: Large production workloads vary widely in request patterns; teams frequently under-configure batching and caching defaults and miss quantization opportunities, leading to higher per-token costs. This PR implements an autotune controller that suggests and applies safe defaults for batching and KV-cache policies, introduces curated quantization profile templates per model family, and ships a minimal unit-economics dashboard and CLI to help teams evaluate cost impact. Summary: - Add Autotune controller in serving runtime to compute per-customer batching and cache defaults based on observed request histograms and latency SLOs. - Add quantization profile catalog and model-mapping rules with safe fallbacks. - Add unit-econ tooling: backend routes for cost estimates and a Console UI + CLI to simulate expected cost/latency tradeoffs. - Add experiments/feature flag gating and rollout plan + canary. Checklist: [x] Design doc linked (Linear ENG-4123) [x] Unit tests for controller heuristics [x] Integration test for simple canary rollout [x] Docs + Console help text [x] Feature flag and gradual rollout plan Motivation and impact: Early adopters reduced median per-token cost by ~12% in internal perf canary runs; rollout tool allows product teams to estimate cost impact before enabling. This PR is split into three logical areas (autotune controller, quant profiles, unit-econ tooling) but shipped together to provide an end-to-end experience. Backwards compatibility: defaults are opt-in behind feature flag; when disabled runtime falls back to existing static defaults. Rollout: feature-flagged, start with internal customers and 10% canary, monitor regressions via existing quality evals and latency SLO dashboards. Testing: unit tests for heuristics, end-to-end canary tests in perf-lab, manual verification on Dedicated clusters. Related linear/Jira: ENG-4123, ENG-4250, SUP-88. See commits for file-level changes.
commits: feat(autotune): add controller scaffold and heuristic lib
feat(quant): add profile catalog + mapping rules
feat(uecon): add backend cost routes and basic Console UI
test(autotune): unit tests for hist-based heuristics
ci: add canary pipeline job for perf-lab
review_comments: Luis: Left a few nits around controller time-series windowing and edge case for bursty tenants (see inline). Aisha: Asked to add an integration test for Dedicated cluster behavior and to make quant mapping fallback explicit in code. Benji: Approved after autotune unit tests and canary job added. Author replies: addressed time-windowing with decaying histogram weights; added Dedicated integration test and explicit profile fallback; updated docs with rollout steps.
